intervention_contract.history_shuffle: deterministic permutation of observed prefix only; preserves token multiset and destroys order
intervention_contract.history_truncation: sliding last-L observed tokens replayed from zero hidden state
intervention_contract.periodic_hidden_reset: fixed half-cycle blocks replayed from zero hidden state; R1 equals frozen latest-only
intervention_contract.last_outcome_only: both frozen parent GRU latest-token view and independently retrained exact-budget stateless FNN
intervention_contract.weight_policy: all frozen interventions reuse bit-identical parent weights; only exact-MF capacity comparator is independently trained on T3.2.7 train/validation split

mechanism_verdict.rule: all four paired 95% lower bounds must exceed zero at both cutoffs

claim_boundary.allowed: frozen causal history interventions and independently retrained exact-budget latest-only comparison on the registered finite-cutoff two-level ten-cycle model
forbidden: device, RTL, FPGA, or board performance
